committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 19 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ads spend collapsed from $155.61 to $6.27 over the last 7 days as the credit ran dry (creditRemainingExGst is now $0) and campaignStatus shows PAUSED; the test has burned $754.48 ex-GST across 108 raw paid clicks since 6 Oct.

No external account changes in the last 24h or 7 days, so the test numbers are not contaminated by outside edits; impressionShare30d has dropped to 10% with rankLost30d at 75.8%, consistent with spend drying up rather than any mechanics problem.

Raw paid clicks sit at 108, well past the click-25 freeze point, with ask_cta_click at 17 against review_cta_click still at zero: plenty of people engage the short question form but none have progressed to booking the review.

eventsSinceStart shows generate_lead at 3, on top of the one genuine enquiry from 23 Sept; none of these are confirmed qualified yet and each needs grading in the test log against the real-business-plus-repeatable-process-plus-named-system rule.

actions.text: Chris should check the test log now: raw paid clicks have reached 108, well past the 75 trigger; if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag is confirmed.

creditRemainingExGst is at $0, so apply the decision rule: pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review; with review_cta_click still at zero, the pause stands.
generate_lead has fired 3 times since the test started. Check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for each one's source and grade them against the qualified rule before counting any as real demand.
The landing page remains frozen past click 25, now well past it at 108 raw clicks: no headline, offer or CTA changes unless something is broken.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.
